changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_id_seq_heal(bigint): a SECURITY DEFINER function, search_path pinned, that raises the collection_id sequence to a floor and never lowers it; EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted to nexus_svc, which holds no UPDATE on the sequence (RDR-229 P3.8). DATA EFFECT: none; a function definition and a privilege, no row read or written.
